title: Moving a file into a workspace that has a nested node_modules silently switches which copy of a bare package it loads

expectedChecks.reason: bare 'dep' from packages/x/report.ts loads packages/x/node_modules/dep (2.0) instead of node_modules/dep (1.0); TS sees @types/dep both times

notes: environment/ holds the untracked installs: node_modules/dep 1.0 with @types/dep, packages/x/node_modules/dep 2.0 (untyped).
